relation_scoring: model-assigned sparse overrides above declared 0.05 low default
candidate_pool: union of observed typed components, optional terminal-punctuation trim, all compatible binary slots, generated native multisource slots and endpoint variants; full legal label set for every included slot
initial_selection: MCR 0.4 density + 0.4 coherence + 0.2 validity; relation verification uses q_R>=0.5; selected invalid graph means explicit failure
ablation: RelationOnly on same initial graph, finite universe, scores, budgets, and evaluator
case_rule: first lexicographic document ID in improvement/harm/unchanged categories; do not discard documents with failures
